Method of Attack: Ransomware delivered via staging server; victims' computers connect to server to download ransomware payload which then runs and infects PCs
Discoverer: Avast security researcher Jaromir Horejsi and Avast team
Impacted Systems: Victims' PCs infected by Cerber ransomware
Attack Vector: Connection to staging server (hxxp://truthforeyoue.top/search.php) exploited due to server misconfiguration
